items.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: Didn’t Ellington say something about that?

ctx.x: groove. Everybody just sails right along and you can feel it. There’s another thing that I got from Joe, and singers in general, but he told me that, you know, when he was coming up that music was for dancing. And we sort of got away from that. And when calls off a tempo, and a lot of guys, when they get ready to call off a tempo of a song, they’re always thinking about where you would dance to it. And every time, without fail, for the last 28 years that I have seen the old guys call off the tempo of a song,…
Didn’t Ellington say something about that?
That’s right. If it don’t have that swing, you know, what’s it about.
